description: This file defines the ConduitContext class, which is a DbContext implementation for Entity Framework Core. It configures entity sets for articles, comments, persons, tags, and relationships, and includes transaction handling methods.

classes.name: ConduitContext
classes.description: Entity Framework DbContext subclass for managing data models and relationships within the Conduit application.

methods.name: OnModelCreating
methods.description: Configures entity relationships and composite keys for the data models.

methods.name: BeginTransaction
methods.description: Starts a database transaction if none is active.

methods.name: CommitTransaction
methods.description: Commits the current transaction, handling exceptions and disposing resources.

methods.name: RollbackTransaction
methods.description: Rolls back the current transaction and disposes resources.
